notes.title: Celebrating Crumbling City's 5th anniversary
notes.content:
To celebrate Crumbling City's 5th anniversary, we are releasing the World Update, which gives all of our cities a major face-lift. This update brings fully reworked terrain, improved visuals and even more buildings for you to crumble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39610685/8d785773e07d7f77a2d99e07d0e15b42121dcf9a.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

Here is a list of the changes in this update:

[h2]New features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fully reworked procedural world & city generation
[*] Some new buildings and decorations
[*] New Mission Type: Survival: Try to survive during a certain time. Destroying stuff makes the timer go faster. City Defenders will be very hard
[*] Introducing difficulty levels: Easy/Normal/Hard
[*] New video setting: VSync (On/Off)
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]

[list]
[*] More animated parts for buildings (like rotating wind mills)
[*] Improved vehicle animation
[*] Improved visuals of each level
[*] You are warned when your health is critical
[*] More feedback is given on city destruction status in ‘Speed run’ missions
[*] Added more debris effects
[*] The ‘Select Class’ menu now also shows the Mission type to help you with selecting the most suitable class
[*] There are now also ‘Back’ buttons in the ‘Select mission type’ and ‘Select class’  menus
[*] Lots of weapon, enemy and mission balancing
[*] Improved building destruction physics
[*] Option to play in PC mode, even when SteamVR is available
[*] City Defender vision cones are now also visible in VR
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] It is no longer possible to leave the mission area
[*] Far away buildings can now also be destroyed with ranged weapons
[*] Fixed multiple City Defender shooting bugs
[*] Fixed resolution settings issue
[*] Lots of performance improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39610685/e3641caac6786cb41b5ee062ac9a3eb86b2c5adc.png[/img]

Have fun crumbling these updated cities!

notes.title: A new era for Crumbling City - Update 0.3
notes.content:
For the past few months, we have been very busy working on this new update for Crumbling City. This version comes with a brand new system for destruction, a whole new mission system, procedural decorations, smarter enemies and a bunch of other changes. We are very excited to finally share this with you!

[previewyoutube=weAEpe5P1AI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
Here's what changed in this update:

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New dynamic destruction engine
[list]
[*] Building pieces can now clump together
[*] Buildings and certain decorations are now hollow
[/list]
[*] New props system that allows decorations to be placed on and around buildings and other decorations during the procedural generation process
[*] Certain buildings, vehicles and decorations can now have a random color
[*] New mission system with 4 unique mission types (classic, mass destruction, time trial and stealth), each with different game mechanics
[*] There's a new campaign mode where you can play through all the new mission types and all the levels
[/list]

[h3]New content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lots of new decorations and props
[*] New billboards with realistic advertisements and some jokes
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Abilities now require confirmation before activating, allowing for more precise placement
[*] Enemies no longer die instantly, stronger enemies can tank more hits before crumbling
[*] Enemies no longer stop spawning when all waves are completed
[*] Spiced up many weapons and abilities with brand new visual effects
[*] Updated every single model in the game to match their scale
[*] Spoiler alert: there's an exciting new animation that plays when you win a mission
[*] Buildings now also have a variety of sizes, which enables more dense cities
[*] Revamped enemy behavior and player detection to make them feel a lot smarter
[*] Updated traffic system to have more natural looking movement for vehicles
[/list]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] We now have full support for more controllers like the Oculus touch controllers (Quest 2 & Quest 3)
[*] Fixed a lot of bugs and improved performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2 is here!
notes.content:
This update changes a lot about Crumbling City and defines the roadmap for upcoming updates. The new City Creator brings a whole new sandbox mode where you can create your own cities! Just to destroy them again a few minutes later. The new levels bring tons of diversity and brand new visual elements like different terrain types. The game used to be very quiet, with only a few sound effect, now there is a plathora of soothing sound effects that immerse you into the universe of Crumbling City. The update also brings a lot of other cool features, which you can check out yourself by playing the game!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added City Creator (sandbox mode) that lets you generate your own custom missions and city
[*] Added random billboard displays
[*] Added trigger that causes enemies to only spawn after the first attack on the city
[*] Exploding bullets from enemies will now cause buildings to be destroyed
[*] Added sprinting
[*] Human-made decorations can now also be destroyed like buildings and vehicles
[*] You can now access your game settings from the pause menu
[*] Added draw distance and mouse sensitivity settings
[*] Added hand and hammer swinging to PC mode
[/list]

[h3]New content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 3 missions (Christmas, Upstate, Wild West)
[*] Added more vehicles
[*] Added more buildings to City Center, Suburbs, Factories and Slums
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added many sounds effects
[*] Improved lighting, visuals
[*] Improved terrain generation
[*] Improved performance
[*] Balanced weapons
[*] Balanced enemies
[*] Enemies will now prioritise shooting you over trying to navigate to you when you are in water
[*] Added more player feedback for boosters, ammo, player damage and abilities
[/list]

[h3]Fixed many bugs[/h3]
